carbon dioxide.en: Forests absorb carbon dioxide and help regulate the global climate.
carbon dioxide.zh: 森林吸收二氧化碳，有助于调节全球气候。

carbon dioxide.en: The new policy aims to cut carbon dioxide emissions from transport.
carbon dioxide.zh: 这项新政策旨在减少交通运输产生的二氧化碳排放。

south-east.en: After crossing the river, the hikers continued south-east toward the coast.
south-east.zh: 过河后，徒步者继续向东南方向的海岸前进。

south-east.en: The storm is moving south-east and should weaken overnight.
south-east.zh: 风暴正向东南移动，预计夜间会减弱。

south-west.en: We drove south-west until the city lights disappeared behind us.
south-west.zh: 我们一路向西南行驶，直到城市的灯火消失在身后。

south-west.en: The birds flew south-west as winter approached.
south-west.zh: 冬季将至，鸟群向西南飞去。

north-east.en: The railway runs north-east through several farming communities.
north-east.zh: 这条铁路向东北延伸，途经多个农业社区。

north-east.en: From the village, head north-east for about three kilometres.
north-east.zh: 从村子出发，向东北走大约三公里。

north-west.en: Dark clouds were gathering north-west of the valley.
north-west.zh: 山谷西北方向正聚集着乌云。

north-west.en: The rescue team moved north-west despite the heavy snow.
north-west.zh: 尽管大雪纷飞，救援队仍向西北推进。

eco-friendly.en: Many hotels now offer eco-friendly toiletries in refillable containers.
eco-friendly.zh: 许多酒店现在提供可补充容器装的环保洗护用品。

eco-friendly.en: Cycling is an eco-friendly way to explore the city.
eco-friendly.zh: 骑自行车是一种环保的城市游览方式。

all-around.en: Regular swimming provides an all-around workout without straining the joints.
all-around.zh: 经常游泳能让全身得到锻炼，又不会给关节造成太大负担。

all-around.en: The school aims to give students an all-around education.
all-around.zh: 这所学校致力于为学生提供全面的教育。

skill.en: Listening carefully is a skill that improves with practice.
skill.zh: 认真倾听是一项可以通过练习提高的技能。

skill.en: Her ability to explain complex ideas is a rare skill in the workplace.
skill.zh: 她能把复杂概念讲清楚，这是职场中难得的本领。

high-definition.en: The documentary uses high-definition footage to reveal life beneath the ice.
high-definition.zh: 这部纪录片用高清画面展现冰层下的生命。

high-definition.en: A high-definition screen makes small details much easier to see.
high-definition.zh: 高清屏幕让细微之处看得更清楚。

science fiction.en: Good science fiction often asks serious questions about society and technology.
science fiction.zh: 优秀的科幻作品常常对社会与科技提出严肃的问题。

science fiction.en: What once seemed like science fiction is now part of everyday life.
science fiction.zh: 曾经像科幻情节一样的事，如今已融入日常生活。

X-rated.en: The streaming service requires age verification before showing X-rated content.
X-rated.zh: 该流媒体平台在播放成人内容前要求进行年龄验证。

X-rated.en: Parents can block X-rated films through the television settings.
X-rated.zh: 家长可以通过电视设置屏蔽限制级影片。

hip-hop.en: Local dancers turned the empty warehouse into a lively hip-hop venue.
hip-hop.zh: 当地舞者把空仓库变成了热闹的嘻哈演出场地。

hip-hop.en: The exhibition traces how hip-hop grew from a neighbourhood movement into a global culture.
hip-hop.zh: 展览回顾了嘻哈如何从社区运动发展为全球文化。

well known.en: The region is well known for its dramatic coastline and fresh seafood.
well known.zh: 这个地区以壮丽的海岸线和新鲜海产闻名。

well known.en: Her research is well known among experts in public health.
well known.zh: 她的研究在公共卫生专家中广为人知。

make-up.en: She removed her make-up before going to bed.
Stage make-up must remain visible under bright lights.
make-up.zh: 舞台妆在强光下也必须清晰可见。

ice cream.en: We shared an ice cream while waiting for the evening train.
ice cream.zh: 等晚班火车时，我们一起吃了一个冰淇淋。

ice cream.en: Homemade ice cream tastes best when the fruit is in season.
ice cream.zh: 用当季水果做的自制冰淇淋味道最好。

living room.en: Sunlight poured into the living room through the tall windows.
living room.zh: 阳光透过高高的窗户洒进客厅。

living room.en: We moved the desk into the living room to create a quiet study corner.
living room.zh: 我们把书桌搬进客厅，布置出一个安静的学习角。

carry-on.en: Keep your medicine in your carry-on rather than in checked luggage.
carry-on.zh: 药品要放在随身行李里，不要托运。

carry-on.en: Her small backpack fits easily under the seat as a carry-on.
carry-on.zh: 她的小背包可以轻松放到座位下，当作随身行李。

well-being.en: Regular breaks can protect employees' mental well-being.
well-being.zh: 定期休息有助于维护员工的心理健康。

well-being.en: A strong sense of belonging contributes to children's well-being.
well-being.zh: 强烈的归属感有益于儿童的身心健康。

lay-off.en: The factory announced a temporary lay-off after orders fell sharply.
lay-off.zh: 订单大幅减少后，工厂宣布暂时裁员。

lay-off.en: The sudden lay-off forced him to reconsider his career plans.
lay-off.zh: 突如其来的裁员迫使他重新考虑职业规划。

father-in-law.en: My father-in-law taught me how to repair an old bicycle.
father-in-law.zh: 我的岳父教我修理旧自行车。

father-in-law.en: Her father-in-law joined the family for dinner on Sunday.
father-in-law.zh: 周日她的公公来和全家一起吃晚饭。

heart attack.en: Quick treatment greatly improves a patient's chances of surviving a heart attack.
heart attack.zh: 及时治疗能大幅提高心脏病患者的生存机会。

heart attack.en: Persistent chest pain can be a warning sign of a heart attack.
heart attack.zh: 持续胸痛可能是心脏病发作的警示信号。

up to date.en: Please keep your contact details up to date in case of an emergency.
up to date.zh: 请及时更新联系方式，以便紧急情况下联系。

up to date.en: The online map is more up to date than the printed guide.
up to date.zh: 在线地图比纸质指南更新得更及时。

long-term.en: Successful leaders think long-term rather than chasing quick results.
long-term.zh: 成功的领导者着眼长远，而不是追逐眼前的成果。

long-term.en: Families need support that allows them to plan long-term.
long-term.zh: 家庭需要能够帮助他们进行长远规划的支持。

up to date.en: The clinic keeps its patient records up to date.
up to date.zh: 诊所会及时更新患者记录。

up to date.en: This guide is concise, practical, and fully up to date.
up to date.zh: 这份指南简明实用，内容也是最新的。

so-called.en: The so-called miracle cure had never been tested in a proper clinical trial.
so-called.zh: 这种所谓的神奇疗法从未接受过正规的临床试验。

so-called.en: Many residents opposed the so-called redevelopment plan.
so-called.zh: 许多居民反对这项所谓的改造计划。

self-esteem.en: Constructive feedback can strengthen a student's self-esteem.
self-esteem.zh: 建设性的反馈能增强学生的自尊心。

self-esteem.en: Years of criticism had gradually damaged his self-esteem.
self-esteem.zh: 多年的批评逐渐伤害了他的自尊。

short-term.en: Rent controls may offer short-term relief without solving the housing shortage.
short-term.zh: 租金管制或许能暂时缓解压力，却无法解决住房短缺。

short-term.en: She accepted a short-term contract while searching for a permanent role.
short-term.zh: 她一边寻找长期职位，一边接受了一份短期合同。

well-being.en: Access to green space has a measurable effect on urban well-being.
well-being.zh: 能否接触绿地对城市居民的幸福感有可衡量的影响。

well-being.en: Financial security is only one aspect of personal well-being.
well-being.zh: 经济保障只是个人幸福的一部分。

high-tech.en: The city hopes to attract high-tech firms and skilled workers.
high-tech.zh: 这座城市希望吸引高科技企业和技术人才。

high-tech.en: Even high-tech hospitals depend on clear communication between staff.
high-tech.zh: 即使是高科技医院，也离不开医护人员之间的有效沟通。

co-worker.en: A co-worker covered my shift when my child was ill.
co-worker.zh: 孩子生病时，一位同事替我顶了班。

co-worker.en: She asked a trusted co-worker to review the report before submission.
co-worker.zh: 提交报告前，她请一位信得过的同事帮忙审阅。

large-scale.en: The region needs large-scale investment in clean public transport.
large-scale.zh: 该地区需要对清洁公共交通进行大规模投资。

large-scale.en: A large-scale survey revealed widespread concern about air quality.
large-scale.zh: 一项大规模调查显示，人们普遍担忧空气质量。

grown-up.en: As a grown-up, he finally understood why his parents had worried.
grown-up.zh: 长大成人后，他终于明白父母当年为何担心。

grown-up.en: The children insisted on sitting at the grown-up table.
grown-up.zh: 孩子们坚持要坐大人那桌。

cross-country.en: She trained for months before entering the national cross-country championship.
cross-country.zh: 参加全国越野锦标赛前，她训练了好几个月。

cross-country.en: Heavy rain turned the school cross-country race into a muddy challenge.
cross-country.zh: 大雨让学校越野赛变成了一场泥泞的挑战。

by-product.en: Heat is an unavoidable by-product of many industrial processes.
by-product.zh: 热量是许多工业流程中不可避免的副产品。

by-product.en: Greater confidence was an unexpected by-product of learning to speak in public.
by-product.zh: 学习公开演讲带来的一个意外副产品是，她变得更自信了。

second-hand.en: Buying second-hand furniture can save money and reduce waste.
second-hand.zh: 购买二手家具既省钱又能减少浪费。

second-hand.en: Children are particularly vulnerable to second-hand smoke.
second-hand.zh: 儿童尤其容易受到二手烟的伤害。

far-reaching.en: The court's decision could have far-reaching consequences for online privacy.
far-reaching.zh: 法院的裁决可能对网络隐私产生深远影响。

far-reaching.en: Climate change is a far-reaching problem that no country can solve alone.
far-reaching.zh: 气候变化影响深远，任何国家都无法独自解决。

cross-cultural.en: Study-abroad programmes help students develop cross-cultural awareness.
cross-cultural.zh: 留学项目有助于培养学生的跨文化意识。
跨文化交流离不开耐心。

self-sufficient.en: The island aims to become self-sufficient in renewable energy.
self-sufficient.zh: 这座岛希望实现可再生能源自给自足。

self-sufficient.en: She became financially self-sufficient soon after graduation.
self-sufficient.zh: 毕业后不久，她就在经济上实现了独立。

old-time.en: An old-time jazz band played in the town square.
old-time.zh: 一支老派爵士乐队在市镇广场演奏。

old-time.en: The café has an old-time charm that attracts weekend visitors.
old-time.zh: 这家咖啡馆带着怀旧韵味，周末吸引不少游客。

avant-garde.en: The gallery became famous for supporting avant-garde artists.
avant-garde.zh: 这家画廊因支持先锋派艺术家而闻名。

avant-garde.en: Her avant-garde designs challenged conventional ideas of beauty.
avant-garde.zh: 她前卫的设计挑战了传统审美观念。

self-employed.en: Many self-employed workers struggle with an unpredictable income.
self-employed.zh: 许多个体从业者都要面对收入不稳定的问题。

self-employed.en: After leaving the agency, she became self-employed as a designer.
self-employed.zh: 离开那家机构后，她成了一名自由设计师。

old-timer.en: One local old-timer still remembers when the road was unpaved.
old-timer.zh: 当地一位老人还记得这条路没有铺设时的样子。

old-timer.en: The club's old-timer welcomed the new members with stories from earlier seasons.
old-timer.zh: 俱乐部的老成员用往季的故事欢迎新人。

fat-free.en: A fat-free label does not necessarily mean that a snack is healthy.
fat-free.zh: 标着脱脂并不意味着这种零食一定健康。

fat-free.en: The recipe uses fat-free yoghurt instead of cream.
fat-free.zh: 这份食谱用脱脂酸奶代替奶油。

sci-fi.en: Her latest novel blends sci-fi with a family drama.
sci-fi.zh: 她的最新小说把科幻元素与家庭故事融合在一起。

sci-fi.en: The film festival devoted an entire weekend to independent sci-fi.
sci-fi.zh: 电影节用整个周末展映独立科幻作品。

close-knit.en: People in the close-knit village looked after one another during the flood.
close-knit.zh: 洪水期间，这个关系紧密的村庄里大家彼此照应。

close-knit.en: She grew up in a close-knit family where meals were always shared.
close-knit.zh: 她成长在一个亲密的家庭，一家人总是一起吃饭。

sit-up.en: He does thirty sit-ups every morning before breakfast.
sit-up.zh: 他每天早饭前做三十个仰卧起坐。

sit-up.en: A poorly performed sit-up can place unnecessary strain on the neck.
sit-up.zh: 仰卧起坐姿势不当会给颈部造成不必要的压力。

self-taught.en: The self-taught photographer learned by studying light in everyday scenes.
self-taught.zh: 这位自学成才的摄影师通过观察日常场景中的光线来学习。

self-taught.en: She is a self-taught programmer who built her first app at sixteen.
self-taught.zh: 她靠自学成为程序员，十六岁就开发了第一个应用。

pent-up.en: Years of pent-up frustration surfaced during the heated meeting.
pent-up.zh: 多年积压的不满在激烈的会议中爆发了。

pent-up.en: A long walk helped him release his pent-up energy.
pent-up.zh: 走了很长一段路后，他积蓄的精力得到了释放。

blue-chip.en: Investors shifted their money into blue-chip companies during the downturn.
blue-chip.zh: 经济低迷时，投资者把资金转向了蓝筹公司。

blue-chip.en: The pension fund holds a diverse range of blue-chip shares.
blue-chip.zh: 这只养老基金持有多种蓝筹股。

walkie-talkie.en: The guides stayed in contact by walkie-talkie throughout the hike.
walkie-talkie.zh: 整个徒步过程中，向导们一直用对讲机保持联系。

walkie-talkie.en: A voice crackled over the walkie-talkie, warning us to turn back.
walkie-talkie.zh: 对讲机里传来断断续续的声音，警告我们返回。

mishandle.en: The airline apologised after staff mishandled several passengers' luggage.
mishandle.zh: 工作人员不当处理多名乘客的行李后，航空公司公开致歉。

mishandle.en: Sensitive information can cause lasting harm if it is mishandled.
mishandle.zh: 敏感信息一旦处理不当，可能造成长期伤害。

laissez-faire.en: Critics argued that the government's laissez-faire policy allowed unsafe practices to spread.
laissez-faire.zh: 批评者认为，政府的放任政策导致不安全的做法蔓延。

laissez-faire.en: A policy of laissez-faire assumes that markets function best with minimal intervention.
laissez-faire.zh: 自由放任政策认为，市场在干预最少时运行得最好。

post-mortem.en: A post-mortem revealed that the patient had died from internal bleeding.
post-mortem.zh: 尸检显示，患者死于内出血。

post-mortem.en: The team held a post-mortem to understand why the project had failed.
post-mortem.zh: 团队召开复盘会，分析项目失败的原因。

check-in.en: Online check-in opens twenty-four hours before departure.
check-in.zh: 网上值机在起飞前二十四小时开放。

check-in.en: Early check-in is available for guests whose rooms are ready.
check-in.zh: 房间准备妥当后，住客可以提前办理入住。

write-off.en: Repairing the flooded building would cost too much, so insurers declared it a write-off.
write-off.zh: 修复被淹建筑的成本过高，因此保险公司认定它已无修复价值。

write-off.en: The accountant treated the unpaid debt as a write-off.
write-off.zh: 会计把这笔未偿债务作了核销处理。

chink.en: A narrow chink in the curtains let in a line of morning light.
chink.zh: 窗帘的一道窄缝透进一线晨光。

chink.en: The disclosure put a chink in the company's seemingly flawless reputation.
chink.zh: 这一消息让公司看似无懈可击的声誉出现了裂痕。

chink.en: A stone thrown from the truck chinked the windshield.
chink.zh: 卡车上飞来的石子把挡风玻璃砸出了一道裂痕。

all-around.en: The new recruit is an all-around athlete with remarkable speed and stamina.
all-around.zh: 这名新队员是一位速度和耐力都很出色的全能运动员。

all-around.en: The course offers all-around training in research, writing, and presentation.
all-around.zh: 这门课程提供研究、写作和展示方面的综合训练。

eco-friendly.en: The company replaced plastic packaging with an eco-friendly alternative.
eco-friendly.zh: 公司用环保材料取代了塑料包装。

eco-friendly.en: Choosing seasonal food can make a household more eco-friendly.
eco-friendly.zh: 选择应季食物能让家庭生活更环保。

energy-saving.en: The council installed energy-saving lights in all public buildings.
energy-saving.zh: 市政会在所有公共建筑中安装了节能灯。

energy-saving.en: Simple energy-saving measures can noticeably reduce household bills.
energy-saving.zh: 简单的节能措施就能明显减少家庭开支。

bas-relief.en: A stone bas-relief above the doorway depicts the town's founding.
bas-relief.zh: 门楣上的石质浅浮雕描绘了小镇的建立。

bas-relief.en: The museum carefully restored a Roman bas-relief damaged by moisture.
bas-relief.zh: 博物馆精心修复了一件受潮损坏的古罗马浅浮雕。

duty-free.en: Passengers can buy perfume at the duty-free shop after security.
duty-free.zh: 旅客通过安检后可以在免税店购买香水。

duty-free.en: The island allows limited duty-free imports for personal use.
duty-free.zh: 该岛允许个人限量免税进口商品。

capital-intensive.en: Aircraft manufacturing is a highly capital-intensive industry.
capital-intensive.zh: 飞机制造是一个资本高度密集的行业。

capital-intensive.en: Small firms often struggle to enter capital-intensive markets.
capital-intensive.zh: 小企业往往难以进入资本密集型市场。

narrow-minded.en: A narrow-minded manager may dismiss useful ideas simply because they are unfamiliar.
narrow-minded.zh: 心胸狭隘的管理者可能仅因想法陌生就将其否定。

narrow-minded.en: Travel helped him become less narrow-minded about other cultures.
narrow-minded.zh: 旅行让他不再那样狭隘地看待其他文化。

non-believer.en: Even a committed non-believer was moved by the ceremony's quiet dignity.
non-believer.zh: 即使是坚定的无神论者，也被仪式庄重而安静的氛围打动了。

non-believer.en: He began the experiment as a non-believer but changed his mind after seeing the results.
non-believer.zh: 他起初对此并不相信，但看到实验结果后改变了看法。

go-slow.en: Railway workers began a twenty-four-hour go-slow over proposed job cuts.
go-slow.zh: 铁路工人为抗议裁员计划，开始了二十四小时的怠工行动。

go-slow.en: The unofficial go-slow caused long delays at the port.
go-slow.zh: 这场非正式怠工导致港口长时间延误。

Cantonese.en: She speaks fluent Cantonese with her grandparents.
Cantonese.zh: 她和祖父母交流时说一口流利的粤语。

Cantonese.en: The restaurant is known for traditional Cantonese cooking.
Cantonese.zh: 这家餐馆以传统粤菜闻名。

check-up.en: My doctor recommended an annual check-up even though I felt healthy.
check-up.zh: 尽管我感觉身体不错，医生仍建议我每年体检一次。

check-up.en: A routine dental check-up revealed a small cavity.
check-up.zh: 一次常规牙科检查发现了一处小龋洞。

color-blind.en: The map uses symbols as well as colors so that it remains clear to color-blind readers.
color-blind.zh: 这张地图同时使用符号和颜色，方便色盲读者辨认。

color-blind.en: He is color-blind and sometimes confuses red with green.
color-blind.zh: 他是色盲，有时会混淆红色和绿色。

easy-going.en: Her easy-going manner helps nervous clients feel comfortable.
easy-going.zh: 她随和的态度能让紧张的客户放松下来。

easy-going.en: He seems easy-going, but he takes deadlines seriously.
easy-going.zh: 他看起来随和，但对截止日期很认真。

overgraze.en: If farmers overgraze dry land, the soil may lose its protective vegetation.
overgraze.zh: 如果农民在旱地过度放牧，土壤可能失去植被保护。

overgraze.en: The valley was overgrazed for decades before restoration began.
overgraze.zh: 这片山谷经历了数十年的过度放牧，之后才开始生态修复。

scourer.en: Use a soft scourer to remove the stain without scratching the pan.
scourer.zh: 用柔软的百洁布清除污渍，避免刮伤锅面。

scourer.en: A metal scourer may damage the non-stick coating.
scourer.zh: 金属清洁球可能会损坏不粘涂层。

chin-up.en: The gymnast held herself at the top of a chin-up for ten seconds.
chin-up.zh: 这名体操运动员在引体向上的顶端稳住了十秒钟。

chin-up.en: Completing one controlled chin-up requires considerable upper-body strength.
chin-up.zh: 规范完成一次引体向上需要相当强的上肢力量。

lay-off.en: A mass lay-off would severely affect the local economy.
lay-off.zh: 大规模裁员会严重冲击当地经济。

lay-off.en: After the lay-off, she used the time to retrain as a nurse.
lay-off.zh: 被裁员后，她利用这段时间转行学习护理。

north-east.en: The fire spread north-east under the force of strong winds.
north-east.zh: 在强风推动下，火势向东北蔓延。

north-east.en: We turned north-east at the fork and followed the ridge.
north-east.zh: 我们在岔路口转向东北，沿着山脊前进。

north-west.en: The road bends north-west just beyond the old bridge.
north-west.zh: 过了那座老桥，公路便转向西北。

north-west.en: Cold air is moving north-west across the plain.
north-west.zh: 冷空气正向西北穿过平原。

south-east.en: The research vessel sailed south-east to avoid the worst of the storm.
south-east.zh: 科考船向东南航行，以避开风暴最猛烈的区域。

south-east.en: Most commuters travel south-east toward the city centre each morning.
south-east.zh: 每天早晨，大多数通勤者都向东南方向的市中心赶去。

south-west.en: The path continues south-west through a dense pine forest.
south-west.zh: 小路向西南延伸，穿过茂密的松林。
日出前，渔船纷纷驶向西南。

well known.en: The author is well known for making scientific ideas accessible.
well known.zh: 这位作者因善于把科学概念讲得通俗易懂而闻名。

well known.en: It is well known that sleep affects memory and concentration.
well known.zh: 众所周知，睡眠会影响记忆力和注意力。

non-alcoholic.en: The bar serves several non-alcoholic cocktails for designated drivers.
non-alcoholic.zh: 这家酒吧为指定驾驶员提供多款无酒精鸡尾酒。

non-alcoholic.en: She chose a non-alcoholic drink because she was taking medication.
non-alcoholic.zh: 她因为正在服药，选了一杯无酒精饮料。

non-verbal.en: Facial expressions provide important non-verbal clues during an interview.
non-verbal.zh: 面试时，面部表情会传递重要的非语言信息。

non-verbal.en: The therapist uses pictures to communicate with non-verbal children.
non-verbal.zh: 治疗师用图片与无法用语言表达的儿童交流。

post-date.en: The bank refused to accept a cheque post-dated by six months.
post-date.zh: 银行拒绝接受一张日期推迟了六个月的支票。

post-date.en: Do not post-date the agreement merely to simplify the paperwork.
post-date.zh: 不要仅为简化手续而把协议日期写晚。

self-centered.en: His self-centered behaviour made teamwork almost impossible.
self-centered.zh: 他以自我为中心的行为让团队合作几乎无法进行。

self-centered.en: She was too self-centered to notice that her friend needed help.
self-centered.zh: 她太以自我为中心，没有察觉朋友需要帮助。

Nazism.en: The museum documents how Nazism destroyed democratic institutions in Germany.
Nazism.zh: 这家博物馆记录了纳粹主义如何摧毁德国的民主制度。

Nazism.en: Understanding the rise of Nazism requires attention to both economic crisis and political propaganda.
Nazism.zh: 理解纳粹主义的兴起，既要关注经济危机，也要关注政治宣传。

cross-breed.en: The dog is a cross-breed known for its calm temperament.
cross-breed.zh: 这只狗是杂交品种，以性情温和著称。

cross-breed.en: Farmers developed the cross-breed to tolerate colder climates.
cross-breed.zh: 农民培育出这种杂交品种，使其能够适应更寒冷的气候。

make-up.en: The film's make-up transformed the young actor into an elderly sailor.
make-up.zh: 影片中的特效化妆把年轻演员变成了一位老水手。

make-up.en: She prefers light make-up that looks natural in daylight.
make-up.zh: 她偏爱在自然光下显得清透的淡妆。

build-up.en: A build-up of plastic waste is threatening marine wildlife.
build-up.zh: 塑料垃圾不断堆积，正威胁海洋生物。

build-up.en: The speech came after weeks of military build-up along the border.
build-up.zh: 边境军事力量集结数周后，发表了这次讲话。

run-off.en: Chemical run-off from farms can pollute nearby rivers.
run-off.zh: 农田流出的化学物质可能污染附近河流。

run-off.en: Heavy rain increased surface run-off and overwhelmed the drains.
run-off.zh: 暴雨增加了地表径流，排水系统不堪重负。

ecocide.en: Activists described the deliberate destruction of the rainforest as ecocide.
ecocide.zh: 活动人士把蓄意破坏雨林的行为称为生态灭绝。

ecocide.en: The campaign calls for severe cases of ecocide to be recognised in international law.
ecocide.zh: 该运动呼吁国际法承认严重的生态灭绝行为。

labor-intensive.en: Garment production remains highly labor-intensive despite advances in automation.
labor-intensive.zh: 尽管自动化有所进步，服装生产仍然是劳动密集型行业。

labor-intensive.en: Restoring the ancient mosaic was a slow, labor-intensive process.
labor-intensive.zh: 修复这幅古代马赛克是一项缓慢而费人工的工作。

Bible.en: She found the old family names written inside a worn Bible.
Bible.zh: 她在一本磨损的《圣经》内页发现了家族先人的名字。

Bible.en: The Bible has influenced centuries of European art and literature.
Bible.zh: 《圣经》影响了数百年来的欧洲艺术与文学。

meridiem.en: The abbreviations a.m. and p.m. come from the Latin terms ante meridiem and post meridiem.
meridiem.zh: a.m. 和 p.m. 分别源自拉丁语 ante meridiem 与 post meridiem。

meridiem.en: In the phrase post meridiem, the second word refers to midday.
meridiem.zh: 在短语 post meridiem 中，第二个词指的是正午。

prisoner.en: The released prisoner struggled to rebuild his life after twenty years in custody.
prisoner.zh: 这名获释囚犯在服刑二十年后努力重新开始生活。

prisoner.en: Each prisoner was allowed a brief phone call with family.
prisoner.zh: 每名囚犯都获准与家人进行一次简短通话。

skill.en: Negotiation is a practical skill that can be learned through experience.
skill.zh: 谈判是一项可以通过实践学会的实用技能。

skill.en: Her greatest skill lies in bringing people with opposing views together.
skill.zh: 她最大的本领是让观点对立的人坐到一起。

the.en: In the phrase "the Pacific Ocean," the article refers to a specific ocean.
the.zh: 在短语“the Pacific Ocean”中，这个冠词指的是一个特定的海洋。

the.en: Learners often omit "the" before the names of rivers and seas.
the.zh: 学习者常常漏掉河流和海洋名称前的定冠词 the。
